Task 5.2 Verify runs 'gate --strict' with the default markdown globs. The defaults include *.md, so the linters read SKILL.md (10 hard findings, it quotes forbidden patterns) and README.md (8 hard, before/after examples). Proposed fix: change the Verify to add --markdown "CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md decisions/*.md openspec/**/*.md docs/**/*.md" (what ci-local.sh and the hooks use). Edit tasks.md Verify of 5.2 yourself, or tell me to.
